claim_reviews.conclusion: “Online shopping” and “shopping through the internet” are aligned.
claim_reviews.subject: English cue and sense

claim_reviews.conclusion: Belanja daring is a valid Indonesian expression for online shopping, with daring meaning online/in-network.
claim_reviews.subject: Indonesian answer

claim_reviews.conclusion: Beli-belah dalam talian is a valid Malaysian Malay expression for online shopping; DBP also records membeli-belah dalam talian as a term.
claim_reviews.subject: Malaysian answer

claim_reviews.conclusion: Different-common-word is justified because Indonesian belanja daring and Malaysian beli-belah dalam talian use different conventional lexical choices. No false-friend contrast is warranted.
claim_reviews.evidence_limitation: The references establish the meanings and usage but do not constitute a dedicated false-friend analysis.
claim_reviews.subject: Final relation and false-friend contrast

response.rationale: Both forms accurately express “online shopping.” Indonesian belanja daring is established, while Malaysian beli-belah dalam talian is supported by DBP usage. The different-common-word relation is appropriate; no false-friend contrast is indicated. Indonesian belanja online is a common colloquial alternative, but this is only a register note.
